inputs.userGoal: Create an Azure SQL DACPAC CI/CD proof of concept with equivalent Bicep and Terraform, OIDC deployment, Entra-only authentication, optional private networking and Key Vault, and no permanent firewall rules; do not deploy.
subGoals: Security-first identity: OIDC, Entra-only SQL administration, no stored credentials.
Three isolated environments with approval gates and reproducible infrastructure.
Public runner compatibility by default, with a private-endpoint option requiring self-hosted runners.

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides an environment isolation and RBAC boundary.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Separate groups add management objects but improve blast-radius control.

properties.administrators: Entra-only administrator supplied by object ID/name

reasoning.whyChosen: Hosts Azure SQL Database and supports token-only SqlPackage deployments.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Public mode supports GitHub-hosted runners through ephemeral /32 rules; private mode is stronger but requires network-connected self-hosted runners.

reasoning.whyChosen: Lowest-cost POC database with a parameterized SKU for production hardening.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Basic lacks zone redundancy and has limited performance; production should select General Purpose or Business Critical.

resources.name: vnet-sqldemo-${environment}-${regionCode}
resources.subtype: Optional VNet, subnet, private endpoint and private DNS

reasoning.whyChosen: Eliminates public SQL exposure when private mode is selected.
alternativesConsidered: Public endpoint with temporary firewall rules
reasoning.tradeoffs: Requires a self-hosted runner with VNet connectivity and private DNS resolution.

reasoning.whyChosen: Provides a hardened optional store for future application secrets or certificates without embedding credentials.
alternativesConsidered: No vault for this credentialless POC
reasoning.tradeoffs: The current pipeline needs no secret, so enabling it adds cost and operational scope.

overallReasoning.summary: Environment-isolated Azure SQL with Entra-only access. Public mode permits only ephemeral runner /32 rules; private mode disables public access and adds private DNS and a private endpoint.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: The POC defaults to public mode and Basic SKU for cost and GitHub-hosted runner compatibility. It omits permanent firewall rules, HA, geo-replication, CMK, Defender configuration, diagnostics, and centralized remote Terraform state; production should evaluate these controls.

plan.validation: All dependencies resolve; SQL Database is a server child; private endpoint DNS uses privatelink.database.windows.net; no permanent firewall resource is planned; Key Vault has purge protection.
